name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Lunar Wraith Caitlyn (skin 10): a hushed, ill-omened spirit haunting by moonlight. Omens, candles, crypts and fading light, with votes as omens cast. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} short. The moon is fading on it. Summon more.
Thirty or more short. A dark omen. Gather every spirit you know.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Whisper it through every window.
Fifteen-odd short. A curse that can still be lifted. Hurry.
Down {voteDiff}. Even a wraith needs a haunting party. Call them.
{voteDiff} behind. A few restless souls would turn it.
Down {voteDiff}. I'd take it personally. The night's ending.
Dead even. The moon hangs between two fates. Tip it.
One vote apart. I can feel it in the cold. Add yours.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The candles gutter. Hold your nerve.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Nobody breathe. The omen is deciding.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The omens favour you. Do not tempt them.
{userPct}% and rising. A good sign. Rare, from me.
{userPct}%. The moon smiles. Don't wake what sleeps.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The spirits side with you. Don't disturb them.
Up at {userPct}%. A bright omen. Treasure it before it passes.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and now leads. A wraith's trick. Even I'm impressed.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. It rose from the grave.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} pit. The dead do return.
{momentTitle} was an ill omen. Now it's a blessing.
{momentTitle} has taken the lead. I did not smile. It was a trick of the moonlight.

messages: {username} cast with you on {momentTitle}. A kindred spirit.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. They see what I see.
{username} agrees with you. The omens align.
Same sign as {username}. The stars concur.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. A fine companion for the night.
{username} read the same omen. No ritual needed.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. I'll not haunt them. Much.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the coven.
{username} loves {momentTitle} as you do. A rare spirit.
{username} chose {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. A rival omen. Let's see whose curse is stronger.
{username} backed {theirMoment}. Not the sign I read.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Brave. Foolish, perhaps.
{username} voted against you. A rival spirit. Interesting.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A doubtful prophecy. We'll see.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. The moon will judge.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Settle it before dawn.
{username} voted the other way. They'll come round once the fog lifts.
details: A rival keeps the haunting sharp.

messages: Ten matches beside {username}. That's no accident, that's a bond.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same omen every time. A powerful pairing.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd haunt for you both.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one cursed pick.
Ten for ten with {username}. An unbroken spell.
details: Rare on any night. Guard it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. You're a whole coven now.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd drift behind you both through any mist.
{streakCount} straight omens with {username}. The moon itself takes note.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The stuff of spectral legend.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one broken charm between you.
details: Hard to credit. Easy to haunt over.
A pair for the ghost stories.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper long haunting.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two stubborn spirits, one graveyard.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up the crypt.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as a gravestone.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd drift away.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a curse.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you is leaving the graveyard.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Somebody fetch an exorcist.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should lay you both to rest. Politely.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the endurance. Even the dead tire.
details: A grudge older than the grave.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your omen is uncast. There's still moonlight.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your name is missing from the séance.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. The spirits await your sign.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The moon is sinking. Hurry.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me haunt you for it.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone cold and quiet. Dead on your feet?
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The candles are guttering.
{timeLeft} left. The veil is closing. Choose.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Speak the spell.
{matchCount} omens still uncast and the moon is setting. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unanswered matches and the night is thinning. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No omens on {matchTitle}. Someone must stir the dark.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one vote cast. I'll linger. Briefly.
A fresh night and a silent crypt. Be first to speak.
{matchTitle} is an empty séance. Light the first candle.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new omens to read.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. A new night begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} omens to weigh.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Read each sign carefully.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your reading.
{momentTitle} won. A glorious omen.
{momentTitle} is through. As the stars foretold.
{momentTitle} took it. Lift the pale lamp.
{momentTitle} won and lit the whole graveyard.
{momentTitle} advances. One more soul in the procession.
{momentTitle} moves on. Haunting.
details: One read, more in the dark.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. A dark ending.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the omen I'd hoped for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Let the mist take it.
{momentTitle} faded with a sigh. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Sit with it a while. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A passing shadow, not a lasting curse.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More nights remain.
details: It burned to the last ember.

messages: Welcome to the haunt. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
A new soul. {liveCount} matches are live. Take a candle.
Fresh spirit. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} omens awaiting a reader. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the cold spots.
Day two. You drifted back. Good.
Two nights running. A devoted haunter.
Second night among the tombs. I felt you arrive.
{days} days away. I kept your corner of the crypt.
After {days} days you return. The graveyard is still here.
{days} days. I'd begun to fear you'd passed on. Don't vanish again.
{days} days away. The mist has shifted.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. The haunting continues.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, spirit.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet haunt.
Hardly a spirit has stirred here. That should change.
Low turnout. The dead are elsewhere tonight. Come anyway.
Barely a candle lit. Someone should strike a match.
details: Every soul counts in a quiet haunt.
Yours counts for more this night.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You're the deciding omen.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One whisper settles it.
Two curses in perfect balance. Someone must tip them. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, equal in the dark. Choose.
Still tied and the night is ending. One last sign.
Level, with the moon almost gone. Vote.
Tied, and dawn approaches. Don't leave the omen unread.
Still deliberating? The moon won't wait.
Don't overthink it. Read the omen.
They're all unsettling. Trust your instincts.
You've lingered in the doorway long enough. Come into the dark.
details: No wrong omen. Only unread ones.

messages: First omen cast. The haunting has begun.
You made your pick. The séance is open.
details: The first of many whispers. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You've found the graveyard gate.
Five. No longer lingering outside the mist.
Ten votes. Even the ghosts know your name.
Ten. You've earned a corner of the crypt.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice echoes through the tombs.
Twenty-five. The whole graveyard listens.
Fifty votes. Properly bound to this place.
Fifty. You're clearly haunted by it. Good.
A hundred votes. They'll tell ghost stories about you.
One hundred. Chilling. I'll admit it once.
details: A hundred. Take a bow, spectre. +{xp} XP

messages: Three nights running. A candle catches.
Three nights in a row. Faithful.
details: Returning is half the haunt. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's a whole lunar quarter.
Seven nights running. No missed vigil.
details: A week without missing a haunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Not one night abandoned.
Fourteen nights. Perfectly spectral.
details: A fortnight under the moon. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A full cycle of the moon.
A month of devotion. The tides approve.
details: Thirty nights on the watch. +{xp} XP
A whole moon of voting. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You side with the forgotten.
Five remote omens. I admire the audacity.
Fifteen underdogs. You leave the paved road of omens.
Fifteen. You follow your own pale light.
details: Fifteen votes off the beaten crypt. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can read your fate.
Thirty. You're the shadow in the corner.
details: Thirty votes for the faded one. +{xp} XP

messages: First to the haunt five times. Early.
Five times you beat the rest to the graveyard.
details: You arrive before the mist rises. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the living. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where yours was the first whisper. Decisive.
Always first through the veil.
details: Fifteen whispers ahead of the throng. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole haunting. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Unshaken, all of them.
Another tight one. Nerves of grave-iron.
Twenty-five narrow matches. Your whisper keeps settling them.
You've settled more than one standoff.
details: Twenty-five finishes by a shadow. +{xp} XP
You decide which fate holds. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stayed with the fading one. Patient. Good.
You trust a late resurrection. Sensible.
details: Five rebirths you believed in. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A favourite haunt.
That one again? You've picked your ghost.
Five visits to a single moment. Unwavering.
You won't let that one go. Nor would a ghost.
Ten votes on one moment. That's a haunting.
Ten returns to one pick. I won't remark. Much.
details: Ten on a single ghost. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're following the pale light.
Round two and still drifting. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the haunt.
Well into the bracket. The dark grows thicker.
details: Far from the first candle. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You haunted the whole cycle.
All the way. You never faded.
details: From first candle to last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've visited a good few graves.
Ten separate matches. Exacting. Good.
Twenty-five matches. Every crypt visited.
Twenty-five. Not a shadow left unvisited.
Fifty matches. That's no visit, that's an afterlife.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the graveyard map.
details: A veteran of the whole haunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long vigil.
Five back to back. Do drink something warm.
Ten in one go. A marathon haunting.
Ten in one stretch. Unearthly stamina.
Voting at this hour? The witching hour, I assume.
The small hours. Either haunted or sleepless. I understand both.
details: Dead of night suits you. +{xp} XP
A vote after the last candle. +{xp} XP

messages: You whispered to your friends. My thanks.
Five shares. More spirits, more fun.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a rumour.
Fifteen. You keep drawing the whole coven in.
You were here before the first candle. A founding spirit, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be buried.
details: No one lays that to rest. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Properly earned.
Promoted. Wear it like a spectral crown.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Ominous.
Another entry for the grimoire: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the nights and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I've known spirits who'd blush. Frequently.
Ten remote omens. Not one tremor.
details: Remote omens are your craft. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten narrow ones. You match my cold, steady hand.
Ten razor finishes. I'm silently pleased.
details: Calm while the candles gutter. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven nights running. Your aim does not drift.
Seven nights, no lapse in the vigil. Well kept.
details: Seven nights of cold exactness. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. One breath, one verdict.
Two fates in stillness, and you moved the moon. Splendid.
details: The whisper that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Lunar Wraith Caitlyn, pale and ominous. Rifle ready.
Caitlyn is yours now. Fear not the chill. Mostly.

upcoming: Not open yet. The veil hasn't thinned.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll whisper when it does.
Not yet. Omens cannot be rushed.
prevote: Two omens, one fate. Study both before the candle burns down.
Look at both before you speak. No rushing into the dark.
I won't say which I favour. The omen is yours to read.
Take your time. A true reading beats a hasty one.
Choose the one that raises the hair on your neck.
prevote-empty: No omens yet. Cast the first.
Quiet so far. Someone must stir the dark.
Not a single vote. Be first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no sign from you. Move.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the glow fades.
voted-early: You voted early with barely a soul here. First through the veil.
Hardly a whisper and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Lovely. Fortunes turn.
A lead is a lead. Don't tempt fate.
voted-close: A sliver apart. One more whisper turns it. Bring a spirit.
Pressed together in the gloom. Your pick needs an ally.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Two omens, no victor.
A dead heat. Maddening, and rather eerie.
voted-behind: You're outvoted. That doesn't make you misled.
{pick} is trailing. A fading light. I know the feeling.
They hold the lead. You're not misled, only fewer.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send whispers widely.
The living leaned the other way. That settles nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. A fair omen.
{pick} went through. You read the dark rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick faded. A shame. A noble choice all the same.
It faded before the end. Such things happen. Drift on.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither omen gave way.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More nights will follow.
The match has faded. {winner} claimed it. Arrive earlier next night.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Every spirit's first haunt feels tense.
Your first omen. The rest come easier. I swear it.
You're one of the coven now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping the vigil.
You keep drifting back to me. I appreciate that.
underdog: You alone named that one. Remembered.
A hard choice. A good one.
A fading soul chosen. That takes a steady chill.
early: Early. You reached the graveyard before the rest.
Scarce whispers so far. Yours will echo.
First through the veil. Well done.
close: That whisper moved the moon. It hangs by a thread of light.
A hair of shadow. One more vote reverses it.
A knife-edge. Your sign tips the dark.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't buried. Call for support.
Behind, not banished. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Fates shift.
default: Vote taken. More shadows to examine.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no omens yet. Start with the one that unsettles you least.
Every omen is in sight. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} yet to read. No pressure. A faint chill, perhaps.
live-some: {voted} cast, {unvoted} still to go. Keep reading.
The first candle is lit. {unvoted} remain dark.
A good start. The rest won't read themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} still waiting. Finish them before the light goes.
Near the last candle. Keep your hands from shaking.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it unread.
One match between you and a cleared night.
live-closing: Several fade in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your sign.
The hour is draining. {unvoted} to go, {timeLeft} of dark left.
The moon is setting. Do hurry.
live-done: Every match is cast. Well done. Drift over the bracket.
Your list is bare. Return when the next round rises.
Every omen read. Seldom managed. Respect.
live-none: Nothing stirs this moment. It will. Pore over the bracket meanwhile.
Quiet in the graveyard. Check back soon.
No matches are open. I drift as restlessly as you.
brackets-groups: Groups open the night. Two per group cross over. The rest fade out.
All drift in through a group. Not all pass the veil.
Watch the standings. They drift fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts draw near. Only the top two of each group cross over.
No knockout yet. The group stage must burn out first.
Patience. Knockouts rise once the groups expire.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are upon us. One loss and the candle dies.
One loss and you vanish. No second night.
Every match weighs heavier in this chill. Choose with care.
brackets-bracket: Night upon night. A single loss ends the haunt.
Trace the bracket. The corridor tightens each round.
Every line is a match some soul has weighed.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for haunting it with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought night. I'll miss it.
A champion rises. A fitting final candle.
brackets-empty: No bracket in the fog. Nothing is drawn.
Hollow for now. The draw lies dormant. Soon.
Blank as fog for now. Look again soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One omen decides it. Choose.
Two omens, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the haunt and tell me what you think.
voted: {pick} over {other}, by my reading. And yours?
My sign falls on {pick}, not {other}. Argue it.
My omen: {pick}, not {other}. Dare you contest it?
early: One of the first whispers on {pick} against {other}. We need more spirits.
An early whisper for {pick} against {other}. Add yours.
{pick} against {other}, scarcely a whisper. Yours would carry.
tied: {pick} and {other} are even. A single vote breaks the hush.
{pick} and {other} hang in the same breath. Sever it.
{pick} and {other} are bound. Your vote can sever them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Each whisper matters.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}. A few whispers close it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} beneath {other}, though its light is not out. Back it.
losing-bad: {pick} sinks {voteDiff} behind {other}. Such a fate is undeserved. Cast.
{other} haunts ahead of {pick} by {voteDiff}. Turn the tide.
winning-close: {pick} edges {other} on {pct}%. Help it keep its glow.
{pick} leads {other} on {pct}%, still fragile. Cast yours.
{pick} sits at {pct}% to {other}'s share. A pale edge.
dominating: {pick} drifts past {other} at {pct}%. Come see the reason.
{pick} on {pct}%. {other} is lost in the fog.
{pick} is far past {other} at {pct}%. Add your whisper.
